existing_practices.biological_role: Whey given before the studied meal delayed scintigraphic gastric emptying and stimulated insulin and gut hormones.
existing_practices.evidence_limitation: Eight adults with diet-controlled type 2 diabetes; 55 g whey 30 min before the meal, additional energy, acute results. No universal preload prescription or direct requirement.
existing_practices.reader_description: Whey given before the studied meal delayed scintigraphic gastric emptying and stimulated insulin and gut hormones.

existing_practices.input: The tested semolina pasta matrix in place of semolina bread or couscous
existing_practices.biological_role: The pasta matrix retained starch within larger particles and a protein network during the assessed digestion steps.
existing_practices.evidence_limitation: Separate human and simulated-digestion experiments; appearance slowing is inferred, not quantified. The result does not apply to every pasta or processing method.
existing_practices.reader_description: The pasta matrix retained starch within larger particles and a protein network during the assessed digestion steps.

existing_practices.input: Cooling and reheating the tested chickpea pasta
existing_practices.biological_role: Cooling and reheating increased measured resistant starch in this pasta, reducing the readily digestible fraction as a plausible entry-pathway change.
existing_practices.evidence_limitation: Twelve healthy adults; 24 h at 4 °C and the tested reheating method. Glucose entry was not measured and digestible carbohydrate was not re-matched after processing.
existing_practices.reader_description: Cooling and reheating increased measured resistant starch in this pasta, reducing the readily digestible fraction as a plausible entry-pathway change.

existing_practices.input: The tested beta-glucan addition to a polenta meal
existing_practices.biological_role: The studied 5 g beta-glucan addition redistributed exogenous glucose appearance from the first two hours to later in the six-hour period.
existing_practices.evidence_limitation: Twelve overweight adults; no lower overall appearing quantity and no universal fibre effect. Viscosity is a proposed explanation, not a measured mediator.
existing_practices.reader_description: The studied 5 g beta-glucan addition redistributed exogenous glucose appearance from the first two hours to later in the six-hour period.

existing_practices.input: The tested guar–chickpea flour flatbread blend
existing_practices.biological_role: The 4% guar and 15% chickpea flour formulation modestly reduced four-hour exogenous glucose appearance in the tested flatbread.
existing_practices.evidence_limitation: The primary half-absorption-time endpoint did not change significantly; larger liver-production and disposal changes also occurred. No isolated guar effect or general fibre requirement.
existing_practices.reader_description: The 4% guar and 15% chickpea flour formulation modestly reduced four-hour exogenous glucose appearance in the tested flatbread.

existing_practices.input: Isomaltulose instead of sucrose in the studied sugar-load comparison
existing_practices.biological_role: The tested substitution slowed estimated oral-glucose appearance under the study conditions.
existing_practices.evidence_limitation: Eleven adults with type 2 diabetes under a clamp; not an instruction to add sugar. A separate 12-week trial did not show an HbA1c advantage.
existing_practices.reader_description: The tested substitution slowed estimated oral-glucose appearance under the study conditions.

existing_practices.input: Vinegar with the studied starchy meal
existing_practices.biological_role: The matched-meal trial supports a possible delay in gastric delivery from its lower paracetamol-marker response.
existing_practices.evidence_limitation: Indirect marker in ten healthy volunteers, no appearance flux. Further delay occurred in diabetic gastroparesis and may be disadvantageous; do not apply this practice to that context.
existing_practices.reader_description: The matched-meal trial supports a possible delay in gastric delivery from its lower paracetamol-marker response.
